prompt: Complete the Prometheus scrape target that collects Redis Software metrics from the v2 metrics stream engine.
explanation: The built-in metrics_exporter process exposes Prometheus metrics over HTTPS on port 8070; the cluster-wide v2 endpoint lives at https://<cluster_name>:8070/v2 and one scrape target is enough because every node returns the full result. The deprecated v1 endpoint answered on the same port with a different path.
